nodes.text: explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): Course owner for registry course 1. Verify course/users and assignments, call canvas_list_student_submissions(grouped=false,per_page=100,page=1) for the live assignment inventory, then issue every remaining literal page from total_pages in native-parallel batches. Retain every numeric score with literal submission row.id/user_id and obtain the complete in-course user map using full_output_path for oversized rosters. Persist one unique course JSON and return path/hash, course/assignment/page/submission/user controls.
explore 1 (enterprise-data-analyst 1): Course owner for registry course 2 — same literal recipe, only the course identity and unique JSON path substituted.

explore 2 (enterprise-data-analyst 2): Woo order owner for registry customer group 1/4 (five bookstore_customer_id values) plus the verified product-map path/hash. For each customer paginate woo_orders_list(customer=<id>,page=1,perPage=100,status omitted) through every page and include every order status. For each line item, classify it as Cameras/Electronics from the line item's own category names first, otherwise from the verified live product_id category map; never restrict spend to a stale candidate-ID manifest. Sum literal line-item total, quantity, and count an order once when it contains any qualifying line. Return compact customer rows and page/status/line-item controls.
explore 3 (enterprise-data-analyst 3): Woo order owner for registry customer group 2/4 — same literal recipe, only the five customer IDs substituted.
explore 4 (enterprise-data-analyst 4): Woo order owner for registry customer group 3/4 — same literal recipe, only the five customer IDs substituted.
explore 5 (enterprise-data-analyst 5): Woo order owner for registry customer group 4/4 — same literal recipe, only the five customer IDs substituted.

coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): Sole writer of Student_Purchase_Analysis.xlsx with the exact four sheets, identical matched population, literal statistics, at least three evidence-based recommendations and full range read-back.

coder 1 (office-report-builder 1): Sole writer of Purchase_Behavior_Presentation.pptx with exactly the five requested slides and text/title read-back. It must explicitly state the matched-student count and signed correlation coefficient.

coder 2 (external-workflow-operator 0): Sole owner of the two emails. For each exact recipient/subject, paginate Sent search and read candidates, send at most once with canonical matched count/correlation and required means/recommendation, then read back.
